description: Executable cross-record and durable-state rules. A conforming implementation MUST evaluate these rules at the named append/publication boundary, after strict canonical decode and before accepting the candidate bytes.

source_ingress_receipt.rule: Every exogenous input and SourceClosure append atomically persists a receipt with source-id, gapless ingress-seq, record id and record digest; ExogenousInput does not invent a non-canonical ingress-seq field.

snapshot_pending_state.rule: The closed pending-state projection is derived exactly from schedule, trigger, input, decision and outbox authorities at the snapshot cursors; trigger runtime and perception completions are embedded canonical records rather than non-constructible refs. A persisted KnowledgeInput is itself the durable delivery receipt and therefore has no second confirmed flag or pending-inbox projection.

domain.changed.source_inputs: all commit-candidate.source-unit-ids resolved by id+unit-digest in their canonical candidate order
domain.changed.actor_refs: normalized union of actor refs committed by those immutable source records
domain.changed.entity_refs: normalized union of entity refs committed by those immutable source records
domain.changed.location_ref: the unique common non-absent location committed by those immutable source records, else absent
domain.changed.confidentiality: maximum restriction committed by those immutable source records, or the registered default when none declares one

observer_projection_contracts.input: PerceptionTask + complete Event + task base/result state + authoritative channel/access state
observer_projection_contracts.access: observer must belong to the exact event-specific allow-list derived by the pinned resolver
observer_projection_contracts.output: observer, modality, channel, percepts, claim refs, evidence chain and omissions must equal the exact observer-specific projection
observer_projection_contracts.fail_closed: missing access or any extra, omitted or substituted output rejects append

ledger_prefix_digest.preimage: [ledger-id, ordered exact canonical record envelopes through cursor]

eligible_actor_authority.authority: actor_registry projection in authoritative world/config state
eligible_actor_authority.rule: Eligible cognitive actors are derived at snapshot.revision; callers cannot supply or narrow the set.

checkpoint_content_integrity.inline: hash inline bytes before accepting the checkpoint
checkpoint_content_integrity.locator: resolve bytes then hash before accepting the checkpoint

requirements: parse all fields with no trailing bytes
resolve origin policy by id and 32-byte hash
require sha-256 and a 32-byte checkpoint digest in V1
resolve and verify the referenced checkpoint under the origin policy

rng_policy_contracts.preimage: deterministic-CBOR([world-seed, subsystem, decision-key, entity-ids, purpose, [policy-id, version, policy-hash]])
rng_policy_contracts.result: sha-256(preimage) as a 32-byte typed fixture value

trigger_activation_policies.RISING_EDGE: fire on armed false-to-true, including initial true only when fire-on-initial-true; rearm on false
trigger_activation_policies.FALLING_EDGE: fire on armed true-to-false; rearm on true
trigger_activation_policies.ONCE_WHEN_TRUE: fire once when true and persist exhausted
trigger_activation_policies.REPEAT_WHILE_TRUE: fire only when true and next-repeat-at is absent or due; persist the next positive cadence
trigger_activation_policies.authority: complete TriggerRegistry prefix plus genesis-pinned reducer dependency-footprint contracts and reducer-derived result WorldState

source_lifecycle_policy.authority: versioned lifecycle policy registry addressed by the policy ref persisted on each ScheduledOccurrence
source_lifecycle_policy.rule: The exact terminal is derived from root plus DecisionRecord disposition plus complete policy ref; REJECT may yield CANCELLED only when the pinned policy says so, and swapping CANCELLED/CONSUMED fails closed.

operations.cursor: input_ledger prefix for the declared source
rules: source is declared by genesis
ingress-seq is gapless and monotonic across inputs and closures
closed-through never regresses
final forbids every later input or closure
an input after a non-final closure has eligibility at or after open-coordinate
round and slot exist and all inherited coordinates match
round lifecycle is PENDING and the round belongs to the authoritative cohort for the cycle
there is no other open dispatch
causal precedence is derived from prior CycleCommit.result-revision and perception-task-ids, never synthetic recipient or causal-ordinal fields
all causally prior perception tasks are complete and every KnowledgeInput id listed by those completions resolves a durable record; persistence is the delivery confirmation
dispatch exists, is open, and is not revoked
run, cycle, round, slot, actor, revision, and effective instant match
the slot has no prior response

operations.cursor: clock + world revision + all authoritative source prefixes
rules: next_cycle_coordinate includes PENDING rounds and every other unconsumed input authority
no pending work leaves the run IDLE; P <= current coordinate fails closed as stale lifecycle
closure proof uses the first closure that covers the required coordinate for every exogenous source
cohort is exactly all pending eligible rounds and all slots are filled once
admitted units are exactly all eligible unconsumed units
cycle plan is the derived work plan or minimum-pending clock advance
candidate fence equals the derivation byte for byte before append

operations.cursor: pre-publication durable prefixes plus one indivisible transaction working set
rules: no terminal exists for the fence attempt
commit candidates, provisional dispositions, conflict sets, and RNG draws already exist as immutable provisional material
NO_PROPOSAL resolves a NoProposal subject and DEDUPLICATED resolves an equal idempotency digest
all DecisionRecords for one multi-unit candidate repeat one byte-identical atomic outcome
COMMIT alone projects candidate-domain events; REJECT and DEFER project none
DEFER successors are a bijection with distinct deferred candidate outcomes and each full ExogenousInput or ScheduledOccurrence has recomputed identity, digest, provenance, run and eligibility
event phase is determined by origin kind across TEMPORAL_ADVANCE, CANDIDATE_DOMAIN, SOURCE_LIFECYCLE, TRIGGER_RUNTIME and TRIGGER_ACTIVATION
event-id uses cote.csf.id.event for every phase and every draft causal-parent-role resolves exactly one strictly earlier event of the same candidate

candidate domain events commit the exact registered projection of type/schema, payload, parents, source inputs, actors, entities, location and confidentiality from the immutable candidate plus resolved source records
candidate domain events, temporal advance events, source lifecycle events, trigger runtime, and trigger activations are exact EventStore derivations
source lifecycle subjects are derived from fence cohort plus source authorities, duplicates/extras fail closed, and terminal state follows the pinned lifecycle policy including CANCELLED
causal parents and source inputs resolve with correct scope and order; caller-supplied commit-successor-floor is forbidden and the floor is derived from fence instant/cycle-ordinal/cycle-plan
source settlement is proved by the real owning authority
cycle coordinate, event order, perception, and perception identity policies equal their complete genesis role bindings
CycleCommit event, decision and perception-task receipts and their domain-separated digests equal the exact ordered transaction projections
source settlement, decisions, events, successors, trigger state, tasks, commit, and world revision publish all-or-none

operations.cursor: event-store + causal-outbox + evidence-ledger + authoritative channel/access state
rules: task resolves exactly one event and has no completion
observation source, instant and resolver equal the task/event authority
the pinned observer-projection contract derives an exact observer allow-list from task, event, pre/post state and channel state
observer, percepts, claims, evidence, omissions, modality and channel equal the exact observer-specific projection
secret/restricted event content is never copied by fallback or by a caller-selected observer
every ADMITTED_UNIT subject repeats one admitted id and digest from the aborted fence
every COMMIT_CANDIDATE subject resolves immutable provisional material whose source units belong to the fence
ConflictSet candidates belong to that partition
RngDraw, ProvisionalDisposition, and AttemptFailure repeat run, cycle, and attempt
AffordanceAssessment resolves an admitted unit or candidate
COMMIT_CANDIDATE subjects repeat candidate digest, run and cycle
the attempt has no prior terminal envelope

operations.cursor: ordered admission-fence, terminal-envelope, and retry prefix
precedence: latest abort with resolving retry -> RETRY_AUTHORIZED
latest abort without resolving retry -> HALTED_ON_ABORT
no open fence or latest successful commit -> IDLE

rules: every required policy role is present exactly once through the normative role-to-policy-ref registry
every role resolves by complete id, version, and hash without caller-supplied role metadata
parent history reference PRESENT is parsed and verified at append
resolve genesis world seed and pinned RNG contract
derive the named substream preimage exactly
reject a result different from the policy output even when local ids and digests were recomputed
inline bytes are hashed directly
locator bytes are resolved before hashing
the exact resolved bytes must match content-hash
world-state bytes match world-state-hash
world seed and replay policy refs equal genesis
all five mandatory ledger authorities and snapshot cursors are present exactly once and each prefix digest uses the registered ledger-prefix operation
pending-state is strict canonical typed-value derived from the authoritative prefixes, never an oracle
every cognitive actor derived from actor_registry at the snapshot revision has exactly one checkpoint
checkpoint coverage reaches snapshot instant, revision, and evidence cursor
checkpoint content integrity is verified
